title: USGS seismic sensors track booms toward Area 51

tellings.quote: It had detected um booms, site booms, coming in from the Pacific heading towards Area 51 in Nevada.

plain: Nick Cook, a journalist who has written about secret aircraft, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in the late 1980s the US Geological Survey, the government agency that monitors earthquakes, picked up something odd on its sensors. He says they detected sonic booms coming in from the Pacific over California and heading toward Area 51, a secret military test site in Nevada. He tells it as a sign of unknown, very fast aircraft being flown there.
